status: pinned for review; inference not approved

official_scorer_methods: local meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct behind OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint
repository.scorer_method_note: The official judge receives question, gold answer, and candidate answer; generation uses temperature 0 and max_tokens 10, and the script treats any response containing 'yes' as correct. The remote API sends benchmark text outside the host; the documented local method requires serving infrastructure and a 70B model. Neither method is approved for this DAR run.

dataset.annotation_policy: has_answer evidence-turn annotations, questions, and gold answers are excluded from compactor input

generation.system_prompt: Answer the question using the conversation history. If the history does not contain the answer, say that it is unavailable.

token_measurements.tokenizer: the pinned model tokenizer with its chat template and enable_thinking=false

compactor_proposal.qualification: DMS-01 and DMS-14 rejected this candidate against their separate decision-model criteria. Its use here is exploratory and cannot reverse those results or admit a production profile.

proposed_protocol.scoring: Answer accuracy, evidence-turn recall, retained-token ratio, question-type and answerability breakdowns, and latency. Compare full history and matched-budget recency with model-guided compaction.

proposed_acceptance.primary_budget_noninferiority: paired 95% CI lower bound for model-guided minus recency answer accuracy is greater than -0.03
proposed_acceptance.evidence_noninferiority: model-guided evidence-turn recall is no more than 0.05 below recency
proposed_acceptance.minimum_improvement: at least 0.05 improvement over recency in answer accuracy or evidence-turn recall at the primary budget
proposed_acceptance.full_history_reference: report separately as the uncompressed reference; no admission threshold is assigned

proposed_protocol.approval_status: All protocol values are proposals. Exact scoring method and run configuration require user approval before any model inference.
